messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert for embeddings-eu-prod — 3 alerts in 2m. Severity: P2. 5xx spike ~6.8%. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/embeds-eu · PagerID: EMD-EU-5XX
Ana C: ack — I'm primary, looking now. Heads up I'm boarding a flight in ~30m but can handle immediate triage.
Mike L: I'm secondary, available to take over if you need to swap.
Tasha P: I can shadow and handle customer comms. Runbook note: common causes are KV cache thrash or model pool OOMs.
Ana C: quick checks: tailing logs now — seeing repeated 500s from model-proxy with OOM messages.
Ana C: quick diag snippet:
```
kubectl -n embeds logs deploy/model-proxy --since=5m | grep "5.." | tail -n 50
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Joel R: Suggest immediate fallback rule: route new requests to embed-lite-v2 in eu region for 30m and enable increased retries. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-eu#fallbacks
Ana C: Agree. I'm going to trigger fallback traffic split to 80/20 (lite/main) and then hand primary to Mike before I get on plane.
Mike L: I'll accept primary after you confirm the split is stable. Can you post the handoff note here?
Ana C: /handoff -> handover to @Mike L. Note: fallback 80/20 applied, monitoring logs and 5xx metrics. Leaving runbook pointer and short checklist:
- apply fallback route
- scale model-pool by +2 pods if OOM persists
- monitor 5xx and qps for 10m
- notify support for top customers
SRE Rotation Bot: Handoff recorded: primary changed from Ana C to Mike L at 1716023600. Shadow: Tasha P.
Mike L: Confirmed takeover. Running scale and observing metrics. Command I'll run: `kubectl scale deploy/model-pool --replicas=6 -n embeds`
Tasha P: Watching dashboards and error rate. I'll prepare support note for impacted customers (acme-corp-eu, searchlytics).
Ana C: Leaving note: flight ETA 2h, will be reachable on mobile for 30m. Thanks team :airplane: :thumbsup:
Mike L: Executed scale + fallback rollout at ~1716023700. Current 5xx down from 6.8% -> 2.1% and trending down.
incident-bot: Metric update — 5xx rate now 2.1% (4m after action). Status: mitigated (P2). Ticket updated: https://issues.redwood.internal/EMD-EU-5XX-1716023456
Joel R: Customer impact assessment: brief errors for ~18m, most customers auto-retried successfully. Two heavy customers showed elevated error logs — support engaged, posting update. SLA risk low given quick mitigation but keep watch.
Ana C: Thanks all. Confirming swap complete — Mike primary, Tasha shadowing, Ana secondary (returning post-landing). I'll update my rotation calendar later.
SRE Rotation Bot: Reminder: please update rotation calendar and add a short post-incident note. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.internal/rotations
Mike L: Will follow up with a short incident summary in #postmortems after we finish stability checks.
Tasha P: Copy, keeping monitoring for 30m. Ping me if error rate creeps above 3%. :eyes:
